Ava: onboarding MonetaryX LoRA adapter. quickpack shows tiny rounding drift after q4_0 quant on invoice totals (0.01-0.06). fp16 baseline clean.

Marcus: can you paste a failing diff?

Ava: snippet:
{"id":"m-042","fp16":"42.50","q4":"42.45","delta":-0.05}
{"id":"m-099","fp16":"0.00","q4":"0.02","delta":+0.02}
full pack s3://redwood-evals/monetaryx/quickpack/1745559876/

Lina: likely quant noise on numeric tokens. two quick experiments: 1) merge LoRA into fp16 then quantize, 2) run q4_aw asymmetric profile. also save logits for a handful.

Ava: started both. re-run with --save-logits for 20 fails. ETA ~10m.

dev-bot: Adapter check: monetaryx-lora passed signature; no secrets found.

Marcus: also try prompt-mitigation: system instruction "Return amount exactly as $X.XX" to reduce downstream impact while we triage.

Ava: ran merged->quant: median delta dropped to ~0.01; runtime-LoRA-on-q4 stayed ~0.04. uploaded artifacts and logits.

Lina: ok, propose canary policy: block q4 rollout for this adapter if >4% of invoice samples exceed abs_delta 0.02. recommend merged-then-quant for billing endpoints.

Ava: will add targeted 100-sample numeric pack (various separators/currencies) and run overnight; will attach diff script for support reproduce. tagging @marcus @lina. :coffee:
